name: Braided Source Receipt
description: A waterproof strip that keeps contradictory source chains legible without merging them.

name: Echo Coil
description: A listening coil calibrated to retain delay, noise, and the direction of an answer.

name: Return Token
description: A courier token that carries a revocable return channel instead of a claim on its bearer.

name: Static Prism
description: A faceted gauge that makes route stress visible as broken coral light.

name: Public Valve Key
description: A spillway key whose use is mechanically stamped into an open maintenance ledger.

name: Resonant Cutting
description: A living transmitter cutting offered only for an exchange that names its future care.

name: Consent Chalk
description: Weatherproof teal chalk used to mark what may be repaired, moved, or left untouched.

name: Strain Ribbon
description: A woven gauge that knots itself around observed pressure without predicting a preferred route.
